name: Rib Fracture
definition: Fracture of one or more ribs, usually from blunt trauma, with morbidity driven largely by pain, respiratory compromise and associated intrathoracic injury.

investigations.principle: Chest radiography is used when complications are suspected; CT is more sensitive in major trauma.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: High-risk patients may need admission, regional analgesia or trauma monitoring.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Parshva-bhagna care may complement recovery after cardiopulmonary injury is excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of one or more ribs, usually from blunt trauma, with morbidity driven largely by pain, respiratory compromise and associated intrathoracic injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
